Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual is a small positive amount up to five, nearly an exact fit that leaves almost no waste. This favors nearly full bins over looser ones, but it may chase near-exact fits that block later items needing those small leftovers.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if r - item > 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
